source.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대, 새 시즌 유니폼 공개…메인 스폰서 ‘NEXO(넥쏘)’로 교체 [Jeonbuk unveils new kit; front sponsor changes to NEXO]
source.quote: 올 시즌 유니폼 전면에는 글로벌 수소전기차 시장을 선도하는 현대자동차의 수소전기차 ’NEXO(넥쏘)’가 자리 잡았다
source.note: NEXO became the front sponsor in the 2025 season. For 2026, the photo in the club's kit announcement of 2026-02-05 (https://api.jbfc.kr/media/detail/news/100674) shows NEXO over the HYUNDAI mark on the front of the home, away and goalkeeper shirts; the announcement's text names NEXO but not its place on the shirt.

source.name: K League: [전북] 전북현대모터스FC, 세계 최대 구호기구 WFP 새긴 유니폼 입는다 [Jeonbuk to wear WFP logo on shirt]
source.quote: 2025년 5월 31일부터 구단 유니폼 상단 중앙에 ‘유엔세계식량계획(World Food Programme, 이하 WFP)’의 로고를 부착한다고 28일 밝혔다
source.note: Charity logo at the upper centre of the chest since 31 May 2025. The club's announcement of 2026-02-09 (https://api.jbfc.kr/media/detail/news/100675) names WFP among the uniform partners that continue in 2026, and the photo in its kit announcement of 2026-02-05 shows the WFP logo at the upper centre of the chest.

source.name: CEO스코어데일리 (CEO Score Daily): 금호타이어, 전북현대모터스와 공식 파트너십 연장 [Kumho Tire extends official partnership with Jeonbuk]
source.quote: 선수단은 유니폼 상의 슬리브에 금호타이어 로고를 부착하고 경기에 나선다
source.note: Players wear the Kumho Tire logo on the shirt sleeve in 2026 (headline: '2026시즌 유니폼 슬리브 로고 노출').

source.name: K League: [전북] 전북현대, 2025 유니폼 라인업 공개 [Jeonbuk 2025 kit lineup reveal]
source.quote: 우측 슬리브에는 현대자동차그룹의 수소 사업 브랜드인 ‘HTWO’가 부착됐다
source.note: HTWO on the right sleeve from 2025. The club's announcement of 2026-02-09 (https://api.jbfc.kr/media/detail/news/100675) names HTWO among the uniform partners that continue in 2026.

source.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대 유니폼 ‘빼곡’⋯로보틱스랩 모베드 파트너십 체결 [Jeonbuk signs Robotics Lab/MobED partnership]
source.quote: 이에 선수단은 올 시즌 유니폼 등번호 하단에 로보틱스랩과 모베드 로고를 새기고 공식 경기에 나선다
source.note: Robotics Lab and MobED logos below the back number from the 2026 season; the photo in the club's own announcement of 2026-02-09 (https://api.jbfc.kr/media/detail/news/100675) shows 'MobED Robotics LAB' under the number on the back of the home shirt.

source.name: Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors FC: 전북현대모터스FC, 현대차그룹 로보틱스랩·모베드와 파트너십 체결 [Jeonbuk signs partnership with Hyundai Motor Group Robotics Lab and MobED]

source.quote: 또 올해도 글로벌 스포츠 브랜드 아디다스와 파트너십을 연장하면서
source.note: adidas stays kit manufacturer for 2026 (partnership extended).

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 K League season. The uniform-partner list is the club's own: its announcement of 9 February 2026 calls it the largest lineup in the club's history. NEXO over the HYUNDAI mark on the chest, the WFP charity logo at the upper centre of the chest, Kumho Tire and HTWO on the sleeves, MobED and Robotics Lab under the back number; Naver CHZZK, Hyundai Motor Securities and Jeonbuk State are uniform partners whose place on the shirt isn't sourced. The Korea Cup winners' patch on the front is a competition patch, not a sponsor.
